precedence: This override is higher authority only for Year 6 SAT lesson access/release semantics, SAT CSV/display-code resolution, and the Year 6/L3/SATS Maths navigation presentation. All non-conflicting Portal V2 authority remains binding.

ownerRequirement.rule: Year 6 SAT lessons must not inherit broad MATHS_Y6_FULL / Year 6 full-view core access. They are released lesson-by-lesson through the normal Lesson Release Import workflow.
releaseStates: LOCKED until a canonical release exists
PRELESSON_ONLY when the normal online PreLesson rule applies
FULL when the normal completed/continuing lesson release grants core access
ownerRequirement.ordinaryYear6Boundary: Normal Year 6 lessons retain existing full-library and direct-release semantics.
ownerRequirement.displayPreservation: Admin tables, CSV-facing state and parent-facing lesson labels retain Y6SMn. Internal resolver compatibility may translate Y6SMn to legacy Y6MSn and then canonical Y6M(50+n), but must not expose the legacy alias to users.

navigationPresentation.invariant: A Year 6-equivalent Maths student must never be shown both Year 6 and L3 as separate teaching curriculum choices merely because SAT access exists.
navigationPresentation.l3Student: Show L3 and SATS. The SATS card exposes only SAT lessons available to that student; SAT direct release must not create a second Year 6 teaching card.
navigationPresentation.ordinaryYear6Student: Show Lessons and SATS. Lessons contains the normal Year 6 teaching curriculum; SATS contains the SAT lesson subset.
navigationPresentation.accessBoundary: This is a navigation/presentation split only. It must not broaden lesson entitlements or convert SAT direct-release access into full Year 6 access.

implementation.mapping: Y6SM1..Y6SM19 -> internal compatibility Y6MS1..Y6MS19 -> canonical Y6M51..Y6M69

verificationMatrix: Y6SMn remains the visible lesson code in Admin/CSV/email-facing surfaces.
Legacy Y6MSn remains accepted for compatibility only.
MATHS_Y6_FULL alone does not open Y6M51..Y6M69.
A direct canonical SAT entitlement opens only the released SAT lesson FULL.
A normal SAT PreLesson entitlement opens only that SAT lesson PRELESSON_ONLY.
An L3 Year 6-equivalent student is presented with L3 plus SATS, not L3 plus Year 6.
An ordinary Year 6 student is presented with Lessons plus SATS.
SATS navigation filters to SAT lessons without widening access.
Shared production Worker retains quiz bridge, Admin tools, Trial runtime, resource replacement, lesson release import and parent email capabilities.
preservationInvariants: Do not alter normal Year 6 lesson access.
Do not renumber canonical Y6 SAT lesson IDs.
Do not expose Y6MSn as the owner-facing code; Y6SMn is authoritative for CSV/display use.
Do not use a second Year 6 teaching card to represent SAT access for an L3 student.
Do not alter Trial session semantics, normal student sessions, protected Answer Packs, online 11+ English PreLesson VR, resource replacement or quiz bridge behaviour.
Student-visible completion still requires prepared access reconciliation/readback and, for frontend presentation changes, successful Pages deployment plus browser verification.
